g.text: Managed attachment reference and model input lifecycle
create upload intent and bind session_id
[accepted result exists with the same payload]
and reject a different active run
all attachments or one safe error
build history plus new attachment plan;
HTTP or Object Storage is the file data plane.
The WebSocket is only the command and event control plane.
Use a binary unique constraint and reissue on collision.
Never rebind after READY or reuse after deletion.
Syntax and uniqueness do not grant authorization.
The Frame never carries tenant, user, URL, path,
MIME, filename, hash, credentials, or Base64.
The immutable service principal comes from Upgrade auth.
Only stable AttachmentContent snapshots enter history.
Read handles, leases, provider file IDs, and credentials
remain transient. Retention records reopen exact versions.
File bodies are untrusted user data.
